Here's my draft digest:

Today's AI landscape is evolving rapidly as agent technology transitions from experimentation to real-world deployment. Open-source frameworks have reached a significant production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises embrace these tools. Meanwhile, startups are increasingly letting model-driven agents replace hand-coded orchestration, signaling a shift toward more autonomous systems. Tool-calling reliability has emerged as the critical benchmark for frontier models, while multi-agent swarms are advancing from demonstrations into regulated enterprise workflows. To address growing complexity, new observability standards are being developed to trace agent decisions end to end, ensuring transparency and accountability across the ecosystem.
